_comment: Every value here is a LOCAL DEVELOPMENT default. Nothing in this file is deployment-specific: a container overrides any key with an environment variable using ASP.NET Core's double-underscore convention, e.g. App__ClientUrl, AuthServer__Authority, ConnectionStrings__Default. See docs/deployment.md.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Max Pool Size=300 is deliberate. The default of 100 (and a previous 150) exhausted the pool under a load test at 150 concurrent candidates. Keep it on every override.

OpenIddict._comment: Leave Certificate:Path empty to keep ABP's development signing/encryption certificates. Set it in any real deployment: development certificates are regenerated per container, so every token issued before a restart stops validating after it.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Turn on behind a reverse proxy or ingress. Without it the host sees http and the proxy's address, so generated URLs carry the wrong scheme and host.

DataProtection._comment: Empty means the framework default, which for a container is a directory inside the writable layer. Point KeysPath at a mounted volume or a restart invalidates everything the keys protect.

FileSystem._comment: Relative paths resolve against the process working directory. Mount this path as a volume: uploaded question media and candidate answer files live here, not in the database.

Mailing._comment: Null means 'null sender in DEBUG builds, real SMTP otherwise', which is the behaviour that has always applied. Set true to keep a Release deployment from attempting SMTP before a mail relay exists.

StringEncryption._comment: Set via user-secrets in dev and environment variables in production. Never commit a real pass phrase.

ExamSession._comment: SigningKey has no default on purpose — see ExamSessionTokenService. Issuer and Audience are per-deployment labels: distinct values stop a token minted against a staging database from validating against production if a key is ever copied between them.
